## The decision this serves

A reader emails to say your notebook does not run. Decide what you should have pinned six months ago.

::: {.callout-important}
**Scale.** Runs in 15 min, peak memory under 2 GB.
Watch **unpinned package versions, which rot within months** — that is what stops being safe on a full section.
:::

## Concept

Pinned environments, cached executed output, and stating runtime and peak memory as part of the result rather than as an afterthought.

**The assumption that breaks first.** That a lock file on your machine is the same thing as a stated version on the page.

## Failure mode

**What it produces.** Frozen notebook output exists only on the author's machine. The site looks fine locally and breaks on every other build.

**The diagnostic that catches it.** Build from a clean checkout in CI; the missing cache surfaces immediately instead of months later.
